_help: Gift -> action map. A gift first matches a coin tier (min..max, max null = no cap); an entry in 'overrides' (by gift name, case-insensitive) replaces any fields it sets. 'action' is what the game receives; 'label' is shown in the feed; 'sound' is a platform beep name (like, gift, helper, sabotage, whale, follow, comment) or null. Gifts worth >= whaleThreshold coins each trigger the full-screen whale banner. Saving this file hot-reloads open game pages.

climb-or-die._help: Read by app/game (CLIMB OR DIE). Effects resolve by the coin value of ONE gift (so Perfume works at either 20 or 300 coins). Tiers with side 'gift' take their side from giftSides (unlisted gifts fall back to the sender's team); all other tiers use the sender's team (joined free by commenting help/sab; no team = HELP). Every effect is fixed and deterministic: no random rolls. Top-level tiers/overrides above only drive the feed/whale banner; the game rewrites the feed label with the resolved effect. knobs = defaults for the F10 settings overlay.

platforms._help: Twitch and YouTube tips are turned into ordinary gift events worth an equivalent number of TikTok coins, so the tiers above (and the climb-or-die tiers) decide the effect. gift.name keeps the original ("Cheer 100", "Super Chat $5.00") and the event carries platform:"twitch"|"youtube". Chat messages charge the lightning meter like likes (chatLikes per message, at most one message per viewer every chatCooldownS seconds; 0 = off). Comments help / sab join teams on every platform.

twitch._subTiers: Prime subs count as tier 1. A gift sub = the tier value per sub (5 gifted T1 = 5 x 500).
twitch._raid: share = a raid acts like a TikTok share (next lightning bolt x2 for the raider's team); none = feed line only
twitch._channelPointsCoins: token mode only: a channel-point redemption is a gift worth this many coins (0 = acts at tier 1, credits nothing)

youtube._minPollSeconds: official API fallback polling: never faster than this (the API's pollingIntervalMillis wins when it is longer)

fxToUsd._note: APPROXIMATE static exchange rates (USD per 1 unit, Sept 2026). Super Chats in other currencies are converted with these; edit or add codes here. Unknown currencies count 0 coins.
